name: CAO

coverage.includes: Undergraduate courses at the universities, technological universities and most colleges.
coverage.excludes: Further education and Post-Leaving Certificate courses, which are applied for directly.

choiceRules.note: Up to ten honours-degree choices and ten at ordinary level, ranked. You receive the highest-ranked course whose points you meet, so ranking honestly costs nothing — a lower choice cannot be taken from you by listing an ambitious one above it.

identityRequirement: A CAO account and an application fee, discounted for applying before the January date.
decisionModel: Points, almost entirely. Each course has a points requirement set by the lowest-scoring applicant admitted the previous year, so it moves with demand rather than being fixed in advance. Portfolio, audition or an aptitude test applies to a minority of courses — art and design, and the HPAT for medicine.
replyModel: Offers arrive in numbered rounds, each with a short acceptance window. An unfilled course produces a further round, so a near miss in one round can still resolve later in the summer.
